    v83(v79, "ACTIVATE SPEED BOOST", Color3.fromRGB(45, 120, 215), function()
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

                if _G.SpeedBoostConnection then
                    _G.SpeedBoostConnection:Disconnect()
                end

                _G.SpeedBoostConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                    local Character = t2.value4.Character
                    local v155 = Character

                    if Character then
                        v155 = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                        if v155 then
                            v155 = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        end
                    end

                    if v155 then
                        local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        Humanoid.WalkSpeed = n1
                        Humanoid.JumpPower = math.clamp(n1 * 1.2, 50, 120)
                        Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true

                        if Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                            local AssemblyLinearVelocity = HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                            local v159 = Humanoid.MoveDirection * math.min(n1, 120)

                            HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v159.X, AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, v159.Z)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end)

    v83(v79, "ACTIVATE TWEEN SPEED BYPASS", Color3.fromRGB(35, 100, 185), function()

                if _G.TweenBypassConnection then

                _G.TweenBypassConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                    local Character = t2.value4.Character
                    local v162 = Character

                    if Character then
                        v162 = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                        if v162 then
                            v162 = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        end
                    end

                    if v162 then
                        local HumanoidRootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        if Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                            local v165 = math.clamp(n2 / 15, 1, 35)
                            local v166 = HumanoidRootPart.Position + Humanoid.MoveDirection * v165 * dt * 60
                            local cFrame = CFrame.new(v166, v166 + HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector)

                            HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame:Lerp(cFrame, 0.45)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end)

function t2.value23(p22)
    t2.value9.Visible = false
    t2.value10.Visible = false

    local ImageLabel4 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

    ImageLabel4.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    ImageLabel4.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ImageLabel4.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ImageLabel4.Image = "rbxassetid://135749776472531"
    ImageLabel4.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    ImageLabel4.ZIndex = 99999
    ImageLabel4.Parent = t2.value6

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://09602722886"
    Sound.Volume = 5
    Sound.Parent = t2.value3
    Sound:Play()
    task.delay(1, function()
        pcall(function()
            ImageLabel4:Destroy()
            Sound:Destroy()
        end)

        if p22 then
            p22()
        end
    end)
end

    t2.value13.Visible = false

    if t2.value9.Visible then
        t2.value9.Visible = false
    end

    t2.value10.Visible = true
end)
t1.value1.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
        local value10Visible = t2.value10.Visible

        if not value10Visible then
            value10Visible = t2.value9.Visible
        end

        if value10Visible then
            t2.value10.Visible = false
            t2.value9.Visible = false
            t2.value13.Visible = true

            return
        end

        t2.value13.Visible = false
        t2.value9.Visible = true
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local t5 = {
		"[>] INITIALIZING SECURE SCANNING ENVIRONMENT...",
		"[>] TARGET USERNAME: " .. t2.value4.Name,
		"[>] TARGET DISPLAY: " .. t2.value4.DisplayName,
		"[*] CONNECTING TO CLOUD DATABASE...",
		"[*] PARKING MEMORY REGIONS & HOOKS...",
		"[*] SEARCHING DATABASE FOR USER HASH...",
		"[?] VERIFYING AUTHORIZATION LEVEL..."
	}

    t2.value8.Text = ""
    task.wait(0.2)

    for _, v in ipairs(t5) do
        t2.value8.Text = t2.value8.Text .. v .. "\n"
        task.wait(0.12)
    end

    task.wait(0.4)

    local v96 = t2.value5[t2.value4.Name]

    if not v96 then
        v96 = t2.value5[t2.value4.DisplayName]
    end

    if v96 then
        t2.value8.Text = t2.value8.Text .. "\n[SUCCESS] MATCH FOUND IN DATABASE!\n[>] ACCESS GRANTED. LOADING INTERFACE..."
        task.wait(1.2)
        t2.value7.Visible = false
        t2.value9.Visible = true

        return
    end

    local ImageLabel5 = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

    ImageLabel5.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    ImageLabel5.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ImageLabel5.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ImageLabel5.Image = "rbxassetid://135749776472531"
    ImageLabel5.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
    ImageLabel5.ZIndex = 99999
    ImageLabel5.Parent = t2.value6

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")

    Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://09602722886"
    Sound.Volume = 5
    Sound.Parent = t2.value3
    Sound:Play()
    t2.value8.Text = t2.value8.Text .. "\n[ERROR] ACCESS DENIED: USER NOT FOUND IN DATABASE."
    task.wait(1.5)
    t2.value4:Kick("Access Denied: You are not whitelisted in the database.")
end)
